notes:
A350 and 777:
• Improved: Films, YouTube and the safety video play much smoother, every frame of the video in even steps. The safety video is now as smooth as a film.
• Improved: Lighter on your PC: the seat screens do about half the work, and the screens no longer cast shadows of their own.
• Improved: Airline logos take less graphics memory.
• Fixed: Tapping a playing film to pause it sometimes did nothing.
App:
• Improved: While nobody watches a video, the app stops drawing it and uses far less CPU. It plays videos on your PC's built-in graphics chip when there is one, leaving the graphics card's memory to the sim.
• Improved: Film lengths are read much faster.
• Improved: If Windows refuses an aircraft file during install, the log names the file.
• Fixed: After the app closed unexpectedly, an old video could keep playing in the background.
